item.title: STA-100 PAA Now Available - The World's First Private AI-Agent Appliance
item.dc:creator: STRATRONIX Press
item.description: STRATRONIX announces the official launch of the STA-100 PAA (Private AI-Agent Appliance). Local AI inference hardware with OpenClaw pre-installed. Privacy-first, data never leaves your device. 2-year warranty. Worldwide shipping.
item.content:encoded:
STRATRONIX announces the official launch of the STA-100 PAA - the world's first Private AI-Agent Appliance.

Key features: Local AI inference, OpenClaw pre-installed, Allwinner A527 8-core ARM Cortex-A55, 4GB LPDDR4 RAM + 32GB eMMC storage, 2-year warranty, worldwide shipping to 195 countries.

item.title: STRATRONIX Creates the PAA (Private AI-Agent Appliance) Category
item.dc:creator: STRATRONIX Press
item.description: STRATRONIX, founded by Donald Wang, becomes the creator of the Private AI-Agent Appliance (PAA) category - a new paradigm in on-premise AI hardware for data sovereignty and GDPR compliance.
item.content:encoded:
STRATRONIX (鼎图太易) creates the PAA (Private AI-Agent Appliance) category - a new paradigm in AI hardware designed for:

  • Data sovereignty - your data never leaves your device
  • GDPR / HIPAA / attorney-client privilege compliance
  • On-premise AI inference for SMEs
  • 24/7 always-online connectivity
  • One-device-one-agent dedicated workflow

Founded by Donald Wang, STRATRONIX is building autonomous AI Agent infrastructure from the ground up.
